<!-- IF: P1 -->
## [P1] compileSdk / targetSdk Not Set to 37

**Risk:** Without `targetSdk=37` the Android 17 behavior changes are not active — the migration is
incomplete even if all other fixes are applied.

### Regression Tests
- [ ] Run `./gradlew assembleDebug` — build succeeds with `compileSdk=37`
- [ ] Run `./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest` — no new failures from API level change
- [ ] Verify `compileSdk` and `targetSdk` are both 37 (check `gradle/libs.versions.toml` or
  `app/build.gradle.kts`, whichever holds the literal value)
- [ ] Confirm `minSdk` was NOT changed

### Impact Areas
- All Android 17 behavior gating (permission changes, orientation enforcement, CT requirements)
- Play Store targeting and review requirements

---
<!-- END IF: P1 -->

<!-- IF: C1 -->
## [C1] CameraX Version Crash

**Risk:** App crashes at launch on ALL Android 17 devices if CameraX < 1.5.2.

### Regression Tests
- [ ] Open camera feature — verify it launches without crash on Android 17 device/emulator
- [ ] Take a photo / record a video end-to-end
- [ ] Test with Android Studio Quail (Canary) + API 37 system image
- [ ] Verify no other camera-* artifacts are pinned to the old version (`camera-core`, `camera-lifecycle`, `camera-extensions`, `camera-video`)

### Impact Areas
- Photo capture flows
- Video recording
- QR/barcode scanning
- Any feature using `ProcessCameraProvider`

---
<!-- END IF: C1 -->

<!-- IF: H1 -->
## [H1] Local Network Access Permission

**Risk:** LAN features (casting, IoT, mDNS, printer discovery) silently blocked on API 37+.

### Regression Tests
- [ ] Test device discovery / casting feature — dialog appears, not silent failure
- [ ] Accept the `ACCESS_LOCAL_NETWORK` runtime permission dialog
- [ ] Deny the permission — verify graceful degradation (error message, not crash)
- [ ] Test on Android 17 device with `NEARBY_DEVICES` already granted — verify no re-prompt
- [ ] Test `NsdManager` / mDNS flows if applicable

### Impact Areas
- Cast / screen mirroring
- Smart home / IoT device discovery
- Local HTTP server connections
- Printer discovery
- Any `MulticastSocket` / `DatagramSocket` usage

---
<!-- END IF: H1 -->

<!-- IF: H2 -->
## [H2] Background Audio Foreground Service

**Risk:** Audio playback stops, `requestAudioFocus()` silently fails when app goes to background.

### Regression Tests
- [ ] Start audio playback, press home — verify audio continues
- [ ] Start audio, lock screen — verify audio continues and notification shows
- [ ] Verify foreground service notification appears when audio starts in background
- [ ] Test `requestAudioFocus()` result when backgrounded — should succeed
- [ ] Test alarm/timer audio (USAGE_ALARM) — these are exempt, verify they still work
- [ ] Test Bluetooth audio output routing

### Impact Areas
- Music / podcast playback
- Background recording
- Navigation audio
- VoIP / call audio

---
<!-- END IF: H2 -->

<!-- IF: H3 -->
## [H3] SMS OTP Migration

**Risk:** OTP SMS is withheld for 3 hours on API 37+; login/2FA flows break.

### Regression Tests
- [ ] Trigger OTP flow end-to-end — OTP arrives and auto-fills within seconds
- [ ] Test with SMS Retriever API: verify the 11-character app hash in the SMS message
- [ ] Test OTP timeout / resend flow
- [ ] Test on a device where the app is NOT the default SMS app
- [ ] Verify no crash when SMS permission is denied

### Impact Areas
- Login / sign-in flow
- Phone number verification
- Two-factor authentication
- Account recovery

---
<!-- END IF: H3 -->

<!-- IF: H4 -->
## [H4] Background Activity Launch Constant

**Risk:** Background activity starts silently blocked; pending intents may not launch correctly.

### Regression Tests
- [ ] Trigger any `PendingIntent` that should launch an activity from background
- [ ] Test notification tap → opens specific activity
- [ ] Test alarm / reminder → launches app correctly
- [ ] Run Android Lint to verify no remaining `MODE_BACKGROUND_ACTIVITY_START_ALLOWED` usages

### Impact Areas
- Notification deep links
- Alarm / reminder activity launches
- Any feature using `PendingIntent.getActivity()`

---
<!-- END IF: H4 -->

<!-- IF: M1 -->
## [M1] Static Final Field Reflection

**Risk:** `IllegalAccessException` thrown at runtime; JNI mutations cause immediate crash.

### Regression Tests
- [ ] Run full test suite — confirm no `IllegalAccessException` in logs
- [ ] Test any code paths that previously modified fields via reflection
- [ ] Verify mutable alternatives (non-final fields, `AtomicReference`) behave correctly
- [ ] If JNI involved: run on API 37 device and check logcat for native crashes

### Impact Areas
- Test mocking / dependency injection via reflection
- Singleton overrides in tests
- Any runtime patching or hot-reload mechanism

---
<!-- END IF: M1 -->

<!-- IF: M2 -->
## [M2] MessageQueue Internal Reflection

**Risk:** `IllegalAccessException` or NPE when accessing private `MessageQueue` fields.

### Regression Tests
- [ ] Run all instrumented tests that use `TestLooperManager`
- [ ] Check logcat for `IllegalAccessException` mentioning `MessageQueue`
- [ ] Verify `peekWhen()` / `poll()` replacement works in test scenarios

### Impact Areas
- Unit tests using `Robolectric` or custom Looper manipulation
- Custom `Handler` test utilities

---
<!-- END IF: M2 -->

<!-- IF: M3 -->
## [M3] Native Library Dynamic Loading

**Risk:** `UnsatisfiedLinkError` on `System.load()` if file is not read-only.

### Regression Tests
- [ ] Test any feature that dynamically loads a native `.so`
- [ ] Verify `setReadOnly()` is called before every `System.load()` call
- [ ] Check logcat for `UnsatisfiedLinkError` on API 37

### Impact Areas
- Plugin architectures loading native modules
- ML model inference with native delegates
- Any JNI library loaded at runtime

---
<!-- END IF: M3 -->

<!-- IF: M4 -->
## [M4] BluetoothSocket RFCOMM Read Loop

**Risk:** Read loop hangs indefinitely when Bluetooth device disconnects.

### Regression Tests
- [ ] Connect Bluetooth device, trigger normal disconnect — app handles it gracefully (no ANR)
- [ ] Power off the Bluetooth device mid-session — verify disconnect is detected
- [ ] Reconnect after disconnect — verify app recovers correctly
- [ ] Verify no `NetworkOnMainThreadException` in the read loop

### Impact Areas
- Bluetooth peripheral integrations (printers, custom hardware)
- BLE + classic Bluetooth hybrid apps
- Any `BluetoothSocket.getInputStream().read()` loop

---
<!-- END IF: M4 -->

**Risk:** `ACCOUNT_NAME`/`ACCOUNT_TYPE` queries from `ContactsContract.Data` return null silently.

## [M6] Contacts Provider Without READ_CONTACTS

**Risk:** `StrictGrammar` exception on `ContactsContract.Data` queries without permission.

### Regression Tests

- [ ] Test contact access with `READ_CONTACTS` denied — graceful fallback, no crash
- [ ] If migrated to Contact Picker: verify picker launches and returns correct data

### Impact Areas

- Any feature querying `ContactsContract.Data`

<!-- END IF: M6 -->

<!-- IF: M7 -->
## [M7] Certificate Transparency

**Risk:** TLS connections to non-CT-logged servers fail on API 37+.

### Regression Tests
- [ ] Open the app and exercise all network-dependent features
- [ ] Check logcat for `SSLHandshakeException` or CT-related TLS failures
- [ ] Verify all production API endpoints use CT-logged certificates (check with `sslcheck.sh` or SSL Labs)
- [ ] Test on API 37 emulator with Charles Proxy / mitmproxy — confirm ECH/CT behavior
- [ ] If using self-signed or enterprise certs: verify `network_security_config.xml` trust anchors still work

### Impact Areas
- All HTTPS network calls
- WebView content
- OkHttp / Retrofit / Ktor connections
- Any custom `SSLSocketFactory`

---
<!-- END IF: M7 -->

<!-- IF: M8 -->
## [M8] Large Screen Orientation/Resizability

**Risk:** App layout broken in split-screen, freeform, or tablet mode on API 37+.

### Regression Tests
- [ ] Launch app on Android 17 tablet emulator (sw >= 600dp) — no crash, reasonable layout
- [ ] Test in split-screen with another app — verify layout adapts correctly
- [ ] Test freeform windowing — resize window, verify no layout corruption
- [ ] Test foldable emulator: folded → unfolded transition
- [ ] Test device rotation on tablet — verify `onConfigurationChanged()` callback works
- [ ] Verify `recreateOnConfigChanges` is set correctly if you need activity recreation
- [ ] If the app is a game (Play Store category): verify exemption still applies

### Impact Areas
- All screens and fragments
- Navigation behavior in multi-window
- Any code relying on fixed orientation

---
<!-- END IF: M8 -->

## [L2] NPU Feature Declaration

**Risk:** Play Store may not properly surface the app for NPU-capable devices.

### Regression Tests
- [ ] Run ML/NPU inference feature and verify it still works
- [ ] Test on a non-NPU device — verify `android:required="false"` means app still installs
- [ ] Verify `android.hardware.npu` is NOT set to `required="true"` unless truly required

### Impact Areas
- On-device ML features (object detection, text recognition, etc.)
- Any code using LiteRT NPU delegate or NNAPI

## Tools for Verification

| Tool | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| Android Studio Quail (Canary) | Recommended IDE for API 37 development |
| API 37 system image (emulator) | Run all tests against Android 17 |
| `adb logcat -s AndroidRuntime` | Catch crashes from reflection / JNI |
| R8 Configuration Analyzer | Detect reflection patterns surviving minification |
| LeakCanary (Android Studio Panda) | Memory leak detection under new RAM limits |
| `adb shell am start -n <pkg>/<activity>` | Quickly test activity launch behavior |
| `adb shell dumpsys activity` | Inspect foreground service state |
| SSL Labs / testssl.sh | Verify CT compliance of production endpoints |

---

## How to Verify All Fixes

1. Run `./gradlew build` — should compile without warnings related to above changes
2. Run `./gradlew connectedAndroidTest` against an API 37 emulator
3. Manually exercise each feature area listed in the impact sections above
4. Check logcat for any `IllegalAccessException`, `UnsatisfiedLinkError`, `SSLHandshakeException`
5. Test on a real Android 17 device if available (Pixel 6+ running the Android 17 beta)
